key_evidence_spans: A 63-year-old Chinese farmer presented with a 1-month history of papules and pustules on his nose
He reported prior trauma to his nasal skin during farm work
Examination revealed multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base over the nasal dorsum
some with superficial ulceration and yellow crusting
He had been treated with systemic and topical antibiotics at a local hospital without improvement
